name: Jeremiah Zeechef
source:
Felix's younger half-brother. He and Felix share the same mom and have a different dad, but he has to live with Felix's dad due to their mother being in jail. He was made to change his last name when he moved in with the Zeechef's.

He is always in winter attire regardless of the season or weather.
